eval: (()=>{const g=__game,T=g.THREE;g.eagle.meshes.forEach(m=>m.visible=m.name==='wing-coverts');g.camera.fov=22;g.camera.updateProjectionMatrix();__ec([-1.05,0.25,-1.05],[0,0,0]);g.renderOnly();const rc=new T.Raycaster();const res=[];for(const [px,py] of [[110,200],[80,215],[150,170],[60,240]]){rc.setFromCamera(new T.Vector2(px/200-1,1-py/200),g.camera);const m=g.eagle.meshes.find(m=>m.name==='wing-coverts');const h=rc.intersectObject(m,false)[0];if(!h){res.push('miss');continue;}let best=null,bd=9;for(const s of [0,1])for(const F of g.eagle.rig.sides[s].feathers){F.base.updateMatrixWorld(true);for(let t=0;t<=1;t+=0.25){const q=new T.Vector3(0,0,F.len*t).applyMatrix4(F.base.matrixWorld);const d=q.distanceTo(h.point);if(d<bd){bd=d;best=s+':'+F.kind+F.i+(F.ventral?'v':'')+' t'+t;}}}const tr=g.eagle.rig.trunk.matrixWorld.clone().invert();res.push(best+' d'+bd.toFixed(3)+' pt '+h.point.clone().applyMatrix4(tr).toArray().map(v=>v.toFixed(3)));}return res.join(' || ')})()
